values: Peer-reviewed primary studies on physically comparable thrust-vector architectures
1. Peer-reviewed primary research only in the main plot.
2. Physical thrust vectoring must be central to the vehicle, not merely a transferable method.
3. Near-exact coaxial/single-propulsion two-axis systems are retained regardless of evidence level.
4. Only a small comparator set of alternate servo-vectoring architectures is retained.
5. Reviews, standalone preprints, generic vehicles and method-only papers are excluded from the main plot.
6. Neural-Fly and residual RL are retained separately as method inspiration.

The close-architecture literature is dominated by classical, optimization, nonlinear and identification methods. Learning-based evidence exists mainly on alternate or distributed vectoring platforms, not on the near-exact single/coaxial two-axis architecture with free-flight validation.
